leadText: Magical Pokémon Journey: How Do You Do, Pikachu? is the first monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the first two chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a section of fan art submitted by readers which was not part of the regular volume.
plainText:
Magical Pokémon Journey: How Do You Do, Pikachu? is the first monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the first two chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a section of fan art submitted by readers which was not part of the regular volume.

== Blurb ==
PIKACHU, CLEFAIRY & JIGGLYPUFF

Hazel goes to her Grandpa, a Pokémon researcher and inept magician, for a love potion to hook her beloved Pokémon trainer-friend Almondo. But the resulting potion doesn't make hearts flutter--it makes Grandpa's lab explode! For the promise of more and better love potion, Hazel is convinced to travel the world studying any Pokémon she finds...

IN THIS ISSUE: Hazel meets Pikachu, but how can she win its trust when her beloved Almondo just wants to catch it? And, will Pikachu be flattered by Hazel's drawing of it? Then, the story of how Hazel saved Clefairy from Ekans and Arbok!
